target: Luis Fonsi feat. Daddy Yankee original Spanish performance, not the Justin Bieber remix

primaryAnalysis.publication: Switched On Pop, chapter 14, Oxford University Press
primaryAnalysis.finding: The public abstract analyzes the original Luis Fonsi/Daddy Yankee song as having two tonal homes and no unique major/minor global interpretation. Root inspected the indexed primary abstract, not the inaccessible full chapter.

publisherCorroboration.finding: The licensed original-published arrangement key is B minor; this is arrangement metadata rather than proof of a uniquely minor original recording.

officialPreviewDiagnostic.limit: A short-excerpt chroma correlation is advisory, not a probability or a recording-key oracle.

decision: Do not promote a single B-minor gold label or accept any relative major/minor as automatically correct. Recording identity, tonal ambiguity and the declared arrangement key must remain separate. The current scalar-key benchmark cannot certify the unresolved ambiguity; the complete accuracy objective remains open.
